name: mod-packs
description: Claude Code mods: a GitHub activity pane, a chat with your own agent beside every session, and a token preview before long prompts.

plugins.name: github-activity
plugins.description: A pane beside the chat showing the people you pick in a GitHub repo: last push, open PRs with CI and review status, reviews waiting on you, and branches without a PR.

plugins.name: agent-panel
plugins.description: A chat with your own agent beside every session; it answers with that session's context.

plugins.name: token-preview
plugins.description: Before you send a long prompt, says how many tokens it is and how much of the context window it will take, then asks.
